 IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CRIMINAL APPLICATION NO. 1836 OF 2024
Raviraj Krishna Aiwale … Applicant
V/s.
State of Maharashtra  and Anr. … Respondents
-------------------
Mr. Dhairyasheel Sutar a/w Kavita D. Vijapure and Latika Kabad, for  
the applicant. 
Ms. M.M. Deshmukh, APP , for the State. 
--------------------
CORAM : SARANG V. KOTWAL &
S.M. MODAK, JJ.
DATE : 5TH MARCH 2025.
PC:
1. After  arguing  for  some  time,  when  we  expressed  our 
disinclination to grant relief in this Application, lear ned Counsel for 
the applicant prays for unconditional withdrawal of this Appli cation 
with  liberty  to  prefer  an  application  for  discharge  before  the  trial 
Court. 
2. Permission  is  granted.  The  Application  is  allowed  to be 
withdrawn unconditionally. The Applicant is at liberty to p refer an 
application for discharge before the trial Court. If such an application 
is preferred, it shall be decided on its own merits in accordance with 
law.
